figures.caption: **Figure 1. Same box, different answer.** Both routers still make Wi-Fi. Only one still gets security fixes, and they look exactly alike.

figures.caption: **Figure 2. The front door.** Everything your devices send or receive passes through the router. That's why an old router matters more than an old gadget.

figures.caption: **Figure 3. Three stages.** In the last stage the router still turns on and still makes Wi-Fi. It looks exactly the same. It just stopped getting fixes.

figures.caption: **Figure 7. How long updates are allowed.** The US lets makers keep fixing routers it approved before the rule, until at least 2029. Whether your maker does is still up to them.

figures.caption: **Figure 9. Which radio bands each Wi-Fi generation uses.** A filled dot means it uses that band. Wi-Fi 6E and 7 add the newest band, called 6 GHz. Your phone or laptop needs 6E or 7 too to use it.
